recap:
BHA Edges Out Ipswich Town in a Set Piece Battle

BHA controlled the tempo of the game, maintaining possession at 47.8% while keeping the press intensity low at a PPDA of 6.2, which was on plan. Ipswich Town held slightly more possession (52.2%), but their defensive actions kept them contained. The game plan focused on BHA attacking the right back, but the field tilt drifted above the target. The decisive moments arrived via set pieces. BHA scored first via a goal from a set piece in the 63rd minute, assisted by #7 Tomas Calloway. The second goal came from a set piece in the 63rd minute, also involving #5 Isaac Kane-Moss. Despite several high-regain moments for BHA leading to shots, the clinical finishing from dead-ball situations proved the difference in this tight contest.
